tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lo gsar dang gtor spod skabs kyi bskang gso'i tho bzhugs pa dge legs 'phel lo// rgyal zla ba'i lo gsar gyi tshes gcig snga dro mnga' gsol skabs/ byon skyems phul rjes rol mo gsum brdeg lan can dang / tshogs byin rlabs grub mtshams rol mo bcams la/ bcom len gnyis kyi rjes su nyi shu rtsa gcig brdeg de rjes chung ba gcig dang che ba gcig yang chung ba dang che ba gong bzhin byas la bzhag go /de nas dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ sogs kyi spyan 'dren la/ baiḍūr sngon mo'i dbyangs hūm̐ 'dren dang bcas pa bcug rjes rol mo bcom len gnyis dang / nyer gcig gi mjug tu choms brdung rjes su che ba gcig brdeg go /zla ba de nang gi tshes bco lnga yan gyi gza' skar bzang ba la/ dpon slob nyer gcig tsam gyis nged rang gi gzim chung gtor spod skabs thugs dam gyi rim pa la dad ring so ring sogs med pa'i nag po mchod rten dang / bskang gso gzhan thams cad dgu lugs la stobs 'phrog ma zhal dang pu dra gnyis la dbyangs rgyas pa byed/ dang bcas pa/ nag po gnod sbyin ma/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma/ sa skya pa'i rje btsun ma/ bshags bzlog rnams tshar bdun re bstod pa rab 'bar ma dang bcas pa mdzad/ sgo rum du nag po mchod rten 'jug dus/ dpon slob nyer gcig skor gyis dad ring so ring sogs med pa'i nag po mchod rten mchod dbyangs gcig dang / mdzes pa'i spu sdug ma dbyangs bcas/ gzhan ma 'dur gdangs yod med spel ba tshar bdun gyi nag po mchod rten ma re'i mjug tu sku dang gsung thugs ma dgu re sbyar ba bdun gyi bar la stong rwa chen 'gro nges kyi dgu tshar rting ma gnyis ltab gcig tu byas pa'i dgu tshar rting ma'i snga ma la sku dang gsung thugs ma rang gi 'dur gdangs rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ bskang thung gzhan rnams rdzogs nas sku dang gsung thugs ma tshar gsum dang /

sa skya'i rje btsun ma bshags bzlog dang bcas pa tshar bdun re/ bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma/ gtor 'bul steng du mdzad/ nang sor zur brgyad pa bdun 'dzugs skabs/ nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren la gdangs thung / gzhan rnams la 'dur gdangs/ gang gi rang bzhin dang / byang shar ha ha sogs la rang dbyangs/ bskang thung rnams dang / gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang / sa skya'i rje btsun ma/ bshags bzlog rnams tshar bdun re/ pu tra la spyan 'dren nas bzung dbyangs tshes thogs rgyas pa/ dpon slob nyer gcig tsam gyis/ rnam dag tshogs gtor ma tshar re'i mjug tu nag po gnod sbyin la drug re sbyar ba lan bcu gcig gis stong tshar 'gro nges kyi drug tshar rting ma gnyis stabs gcig tu byas pa'i drug tshar rting ma'i snga ma la nag po gnod sbyin ma rang dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ 'dir skabs kyi rnam dag tshogs gtor ma dang dmag zor ma'i bcu gcig rnams la dbyangs ring ba bcug pa rnams kyi bar thams cad la 'dur gdangs kho na mdzad/ bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma bsdus pa/ las mgon la rgyas pa dbyangs dang bcas pa/ gtor skyong steng du mdzad/ /lha khang rtse dang bde mchog bde mchog tu snga dro bsangs rgyas pa re byed/ gnyis su nag po mchod rten 'dzugs skabs/ dpon slob nyer gcig tsam gyis nag po mchod rten dad ring so ring sogs med pa'i dgu lugs tshar bdun gyi brgya tshar 'gro nges/ gzhan ma bskangs gso thams cad dgu lugs la nag po gnod sbyin ma/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma/ bshags bzlog rnams tshar bdun re/ bstod thung gang rigs/ gtor 'bum stong du mdzad/ /bsam gling du 'dzugs gtor chen mo gnyis spod dus/ nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren la dbyangs thung dang bcas pa tshar gcig gi rjes su lha mchog ma/ de nas dpon slob nyer gcig tsam gyis dmag zor ma'i sgos bskang rgyas pa tshar gcig dang /

bsdus pa'i bskang bshags re re'i mjug tu gzhan yang ma drug re sbyar ba lan bcu gcig gis stong rwa chen 'gro nges kyi drug tshar rting ma gnyis ltab gcig tu byas pa'i drug tshar rting ma'i snga ma la gzhan yang ma dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas chos dbyings spros bral ma tshar gsum/ nag po gnod sbyin ma/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma rnams kyang tshar gsum re sa skya'i rje btsun ma dang / sgos bskang gi bzlog pa rgyas bsdus tshar bdun re/ bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung bsdus pa/ lha mo la sgos bstod rgyas pa dbyangs dang bcas pa/ gtor 'bul steng du mi mdzad/ dngos grub gling du gtor spod dang / nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren la dbyangs thung dang bcas pa tshar gcig dang / de rjes gzhan yang ma tshar gcig de'i rjes su lha mchog ma tshar gcig de nas spyan 'dren la/ che ba'i che mchog he ru ka /de yi sprul pa srung ma'i gtso/ /dpal mo lcam dral thugs dam bzhin/ /gnas 'di nyid du spyan 'dren gshegs/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig bcas/ /dam rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /nye bar brgyan pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal can/ /dpal ldan ma yi kun khyab cing / /bdud po mthu rtsal ldan pa yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /ces pa'i sho lo ka gsum la/ de wi ko ṭa ma'i dbyangs bcug pa mdzad/ /dkar bdud la bskang gso rgyas pa dbyangs yod med spel ba re'i mjug tu nged rang gis byas pa'i/ dpal gyi bstan skyong ma mo ni/ /sogs pa 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pa/ sbyar ba tshar bdun dang / dkar chung tshar bzhi/ nag po gnod sbyin ma/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma rnams tshar gsum re/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma tshar bdun rnams mdzad/ bstod pa nag rngam ma/ dkar mo ba'i bstod pa la/ spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs thung tsam/ bdud rgyal la bskang gso'i dam tshig chen mo'i dbyangs rol mo dgu brdeg dang bcas pa/

phur srung la sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i dbyangs thung mjug tshogs byin rlabs grub mtshams rol mo rnams bcams la/ bcom len gnyis kyi rjes su che ba dgu dang chung ba bzhi/ yang che ba dang chung ba gong bzhin/ de nas che ba dgu'i rjes su chung ba gcig yang che ba gcig dang chung ba gcig de nas che ba gcig brdeg go /spyan 'dren la baiḍūr sngon ma'i dbyangs mjug bsdud byas pa bcug la/ rol mo gong bzhin gyi dgu brdung rjes ma'i mjug tu chems brdung dang / de nas che ba gnyis brdeg go /gtor 'bul steng du mdzad/ ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rjes 'jug rnams phyag len nges pa'i ched du bkod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lo gsar dang gtor spod skabs kyi bskang gso'i tho bzhugs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
